title: GlobalProtect VPN Gateway Timeout on Primary Connection
verified_draft:
Hello {{sender_name}},

Thank you for reaching out regarding the VPN connectivity issue. This matches our verified historical incident (TICK-8492) caused by high gateway load on the primary endpoint.

Please follow these verified resolution steps:
1. Open GlobalProtect and go to Settings > Gateway.
2. Switch your gateway address to 'gw-backup.knoxflow.io'.
3. Open terminal/PowerShell and execute: ipconfig /flushdns
4. Re-enter your SSO credentials.

This will re-route your encrypted tunnel through our alternate cluster.

Best regards,
{{assignee_name}}
KnoxFlow Infrastructure Operations
resolution_details: Rerouted user client from overloaded primary gateway to secondary endpoint and flushed stale DNS records.
